This is a pre alpha build, not guaranteed to work, and very certain it's buggy in a lot of unexpected ways. 

Otherwise, at least works with Bedrock Waters resource pack here: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bedrock-waters

## Note - we are aware of a crash that happens after unloading a pack. We're working on it.
